observation: County fire is a California fire protection district. The city website and city email belonged to a different agency. Keep the existing county careers destination.

name: North County Fire Protection District (Monterey County)
observation: The previous website and chief were the San Diego district. Do not turn its National Registry EMT/paramedic alternative into a generic California EMT-to-apply yes/no flag.

changes.before: The district promotes full-time firefighters out of its paid reserve firefighter program rather than hiring off the street.
changes.after: The reserve program has an entry selection process and can lead to full-time positions. Its current interest page asks for a current National Registry EMT or paramedic card, CPAT, driver license, high school diploma or GED, FF1 academy, and local residency within 30 minutes of a district station. An interest form provides notice when applications open; it is not an open application.
Part-time reserve program, not every district role
